verdict.rationale: Cursor's security page documents Privacy Mode: anyone (free or Pro) can enable it, team or enterprise admins can enforce it, new members inherit it, and "when enabled, we will not train on your data." That is a direct opt-out from model training. The statement covers Cursor as a whole and is not specific to Bugbot, which lowers confidence that it applies to Bugbot's PR-review data. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that Privacy Mode covers Bugbot PR diffs and comments, detail on data retention and subprocessor training policies, and independent or hands-on verification.
